data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Firebase In-App Messaging campaigns.
data.what_it_does: Allows apps to display targeted contextual messages to active users using Firebase In-App Messaging. Provides message lifecycle streams and supports custom Flutter UI rendering for campaigns.
use_when: You need to display in-app promotional or informational messages via Firebase
You want to listen to message lifecycle events like clicks, impressions, and dismissals
You want to render custom Flutter UI for in-app messaging campaigns
avoid_when: You only need push notifications or background remote messages
You are not using Firebase as your backend service
strengths: Native integration with Firebase In-App Messaging API
Exposes lifecycle event streams such as clicks, impressions, and dismissals
Supports custom Flutter display mode for custom campaign rendering
weaknesses: Requires proper Firebase setup and configuration
Does not automatically open action URLs in custom display mode
data.setup_notes: Requires adding firebase_core, initializing Firebase, and setting up Android/iOS project configurations according to Firebase guidelines.
